reopens.reason: SECURITY HARD-STOP from 2nd independent adversarial verify: cross-tenant Vertex bearer-token theft. VertexTokenProviderCache keys by (client_email, project_id) only — no tenant_id — on a single app-wide instance; a Hydroa tenant reusing another tenant's GCP service-account email+project is served the victim's live minted token WITHOUT possessing their private key, defeating BYOK. Demonstrated in ~15 lines. Gate was erroneously PASS on the 1st verify (rated CLEAR); reversed. Fix touches the frozen M4 cache-key contract + is systemic (azure_ad.py identical class) → Tin decision on scope.
